newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI WORLDBEST BUYS CLOTH MILL.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI WORLDBEST BUYS CLOTH MILL.

text.p: Shanghai Worldbest Co Ltd said on Thursday it had bought a controlling stake in a cloth mill based in eastern Jiangsu province to raise chemical fibres production.
The company bought a 71.54 percent stake in the Yangzhou Cloth Mill for 60 million yuan in July, Worldbest said in a statement in the Shanghai Securities News.
The mill retained the remaining stake valued at 23.87 million yuan, the statement said.
The mill will be named Yangzhou Worldbest Co Ltd, the statement added.
Worldbest also said one of its unit, a B share firm listed in Shanghai, has set up a joint venture with a domestic firm.
Nantong Conjugate Fibre Co, fully owned by Shanghai Worldbest, and the Nantong No 4 Weaving Factory have agreed to set up a new venture, called Nantong Huatong Chemical Fibre Co Ltd.
The venture will have an annual production capacity of 1,300 tonnes of chemical fibres, the statement said.
Worldbest's subsidiary holds a 60 percent stake in the venture and Nantong holds the rest, the statement said.
